properties.title: The Hourglass Key
properties.text:
Narrator: Mrs. O uses a brass hairpin to unlock the bottom drawer of their Victorian desk while Mr. D double-checks their old passports.
Narrator: Beneath a stack of old land deeds lies a heavy iron box wrapped in faded velvet.
Narrator: Inside rests a hand-carved brass key with a handle shaped like an hourglass, accompanied by an index card written in glowing silver ink.
Mr. D: I've owned this desk for twenty years, and I swear this box was never here yesterday.
Mrs. O: Read the card, Henry... it lists our original birth names from before we met, alongside dates that haven't happened yet.
Mr. D: "Property of the Archival Sub-Levels. Master Key for File Pair 409."
Mrs. O: Whoever issued that notice has been cataloging our lives since before we even knew each other.
Mr. D: Slip the key into your coat pocket. If they have a vault downstairs, this key will unlock answers.

properties.title: The Static Dispatch Call
properties.text:
Narrator: Mr. D lifts the heavy rotary phone receiver and dials the eleven-digit number stamped into the lead seal.
Narrator: After a single ring, a sharp, monotone voice answers amidst the sound of thousands of pages rustling in a heavy wind.
Senior Receptionist: Sheriff's Office, Division of Marital Audits. State your Case Pair ID.
Mr. D: We are calling about a notice left on our door for Mr. D and Mrs. O. Case Pair 409.
Senior Receptionist: Ah, Case 409. The persistent anomaly pair. We have been monitoring your temporal cohesion metrics since Tuesday.
Mrs. O: What do you mean by anomaly pair? We're a married couple!
Senior Receptionist: Most couples begin disputing shared memories within six minutes of receiving a revision notice. Your metrics remain inconveniently synchronized.
Mr. D: We aren't disputing anything. We demand to know what authority you have over our lives.
Senior Receptionist: Authority is delegated by the High Auditor. Please report between nine and five before your file is shredded.
Narrator: The line drops into a harsh burst of static that sounds like a choir whispering legal citations in unison.

properties.title: Arrival at the Monolithic Courthouse
properties.text:
Narrator: The Sheriff's Office occupies an imposing granite courthouse that looms five stories higher than the surrounding city buildings.
Narrator: Inside the lobby, the ceiling stretches into shadow, and massive brass wall clocks tick counter-clockwise at irregular intervals.
Narrator: Behind a waist-high marble counter sits the Senior Receptionist, systematically stamping stack after stack of grey manila folders.
Senior Receptionist: Welcome to Floor 1, Case Pair 409. Please attach these brass visitor badges to your lapels immediately.
Mr. D: We want to speak with whoever issued this notice.
Senior Receptionist: Everyone wants to speak with the issuers, sir. But the sheriffs do not handle inquiries; they handle execution of revisions.
Mrs. O: We aren't leaving until we inspect our file.
Senior Receptionist: Your file is currently descending toward the Basement Archive for evening processing. If you wish to catch it, I suggest you move quickly.

properties.title: Interview with Sheriff Harry Persad
properties.text:
Sheriff Harry Persad: Please sit, Mr. D, Mrs. O. I must say, your file is causing quite a stir in the Revision Bureau.
Mrs. O: Why? What is wrong with our records?
Sheriff Harry Persad: Nothing is wrong with your records, madam. That is the problem. Your lives match the 1994 master census perfectly.
Mr. D: Then why issue a revision notice?
Sheriff Harry Persad: Because the 1994 master census was declared non-canonical three hours ago. We are retroactively adjusting all citizen pairings from that era.
Mrs. O: You can't just declare a decade non-canonical!
Sheriff Harry Persad: We do it twice a month, Mrs. O. Bureaucracy requires constant pruning to keep reality manageable.

properties.title: Interview with Sheriff Sig Cho
properties.text:
Narrator: Sheriff Sig Cho stands near a tall stained-glass window that looks out onto an empty gray void where the street should be.
Narrator: He slowly polishes a heavy steel stamping rod engraved with the word NULLIFIED.
Sheriff Sig Cho: I admire couples like you. So determined, so attached to your personal continuity.
Mr. D: We aren't going to let you rewrite our past.
Sheriff Sig Cho: You misunderstand your position. Your past has already been rewritten four times. You simply haven't noticed the seam lines yet.
Mrs. O: What seam lines?
Sheriff Sig Cho: Have you ever looked at your wedding album and felt like the weather was slightly different than you remembered? That was our third draft.
Mr. D: This ends today, Sheriff. We're finding the master ledger.

properties.title: The Whispering Citizen's Warning
properties.text:
Narrator: Mrs. O and Mr. D take seats on a hard oak bench beside a thin, pale man wearing three coats over one another.
Narrator: The man continuously checks a pocket watch that has no hands, only a small mirror inside the face.
Whispering Citizen: Don't let the clerks separate you into Room A and Room B. That's how they broke my parents.
Mrs. O: How do they break people?
Whispering Citizen: They give Room A a file that says Room B never existed. Then they give Room B a file that says Room A died ten years ago. Once you doubt each other for a second, the building absorbs your names.
Mr. D: We trust each other completely.
Whispering Citizen: Then go to the sub-levels. Find the old Archivist before the High Auditor signs the daily shredding order.

properties.title: The Forgotten Courtroom Docket
properties.text:
Narrator: High vaulted ceilings echo with the sound of a mechanical typewriter typing continuously without a clerk present.
Narrator: Rows of empty wooden pews face a massive judicial dais where three leather-bound dockets lie open.
Archival Clerk: Case Pair 409 is scheduled for Docket Removal at 17:00 hours.
Mrs. O: Not if we have anything to say about it.
Mr. D: Look at the judge's dais... it lists the Celestial Protocol rules.
Mrs. O: "Section 9: Any reality revision may be challenged if the subjects present an original Unwritten Ledger entry signed by both parties."
Mr. D: That means if we find the Unwritten Ink, we can legally void their revision notice right here!

properties.title: Evading the Bailiff Guards
properties.text:
Narrator: Heavy iron boots clatter against the marble floor as three tall bailiffs carry glowing brass stamping rods down the hallway.
Narrator: Mr. D quickly pulls Mrs. O into an alcove concealed behind a heavy velvet tapestry depicting the founding of the Revision Bureau.
Mr. D: Those stamping rods... if a guard touches you with one, it reclassifies your citizen tier on the spot.
Mrs. O: Look across the hall... there's a heavy oak door marked "CLERK STAMP REGISTRY."
Mr. D: Wait until the lead guard turns the corner... now! Move!

properties.title: The Stamp Registry Vault
properties.text:
Narrator: The room is filled from floor to ceiling with wooden racks holding thousands of heavy iron stamps.
Narrator: Each stamp bears a word in raised steel letters: APPROVED, REVISED, SHREDDED, EXPUNGED, REASSIGNED.
Mrs. O: Look at this massive brass seal in the velvet display case... "RECLASSIFIED MASTER CLEARANCE."
Mr. D: If we take that stamp, we can forge official authorization passes to access any restricted vault in the building.
Mrs. O: Press it onto a blank parchment sheet... perfect. Now we hold the authority of a Senior Registrar.

properties.title: The High Auditor's Office
properties.text:
Narrator: Inside a glass-walled office overlooking the entire administrative floor, the High Auditor sits at a desk made of compressed legal documents.
High Auditor: Case Pair 409. You are trespassing in the Executive Revision Sector.
Mr. D: We are here to reclaim our records, Auditor.
High Auditor: Your records are property of the Revision Bureau! Without constant administrative maintenance, human lives collapse into narrative chaos!
Mrs. O: Our life is not narrative chaos; it's our marriage!
Narrator: Mrs. O glances at the Auditor's blotter and notes a set of numbers carved into the leather: 7-14-21.
Mr. D: That's the combination to the Reality Vault downstairs!

properties.title: Forging the Master Clearance Pass
properties.text:
Narrator: Using the stolen clerk stamp, Mrs. O firmly presses the heavy seal onto a sheet of gold-leaf document paper.
Narrator: The gold leaf flashes with bright blue light as the text automatically reconfigures into a Master Clearance Directive.
Mr. D: Outstanding work, Henry. Now no guard or clerk in this building can block us.
Mrs. O: Let's head straight down to the sub-levels and find the Master Ledger before sundown.

properties.title: The Renegade Janitor's Refuge
properties.text:
Narrator: Red alarm lights flash along the ceiling as a loud buzzer sounds down the corridor.
Narrator: A door to a supply closet swings open, and a man in greasy gray overalls pulls Mrs. O and Mr. D inside.
Renegade Janitor: Quiet! The bailiffs are conducting a sweep of Sector 4.
Mr. D: Who are you?
Renegade Janitor: I used to be a Senior Registrar until they erased my home town in '02. I've been living in the ventilation shafts ever since, sabotaging their paper shredders.
Mrs. O: There are people locked in the cells down here!
Renegade Janitor: Aye, cell block 3 is full of citizens whose files are half-shredded. Help me get them out, and I'll show you the secret path to the Archivist.

properties.title: Liberation of Cell Block 3
properties.text:
Narrator: Mr. D uses a heavy iron crowbar to shatter the brass padlock securing the door of Cell Block 3.
Narrator: Inside sit dozens of men and women whose bodies are semi-translucent, their faces glowing faintly with lost memories.
Whispering Citizen: You... you can actually see us? The clerks said we were completely nullified!
Mrs. O: No one is nullified here! Get up, all of you! We're breaking out of this building together!
Renegade Janitor: Take these floor plans! They show the emergency stairwell leading straight up to the rooftop exit!
Mr. D: Lead the citizens to the rooftop stairs! We'll secure the master files so they can never erase you again!

properties.title: The Reality Vault Threshold
properties.text:
Narrator: At the end of a heavily reinforced hallway stands a circular steel vault door ten feet thick, fitted with three brass dials and a central obsidian slot.
Narrator: In the central slot rests a smooth black stone token that emits a freezing mist.
Mr. D: This is the Black Token... the physical core that powers the building's reality engine.
Mrs. O: If we pull this token out, their automated shredders and revision stamps will freeze instantly!
Narrator: Mrs. O grips the cold obsidian token and pulls it free. The massive vault door groans as power surges through the floor.

properties.title: Finding the Master Ledger Page
properties.text:
Narrator: Behind a collapsed row of oak filing cabinets sits a pedestal holding a glowing glass case.
Narrator: Inside lies a single yellowed sheet of parchment labeled: MASTER LEDGER - CASE PAIR 409.
Mr. D: Look at section 4... "Anomalous marital bond exhibits 99.8% structural resistance to standard erasure protocols."
Mrs. O: They didn't summon us because we were a mistake... they summoned us because our love is stronger than their entire system!
Mr. D: Take the page out of the case. Without this original document, they can't execute the evening revision!

properties.title: The Chamber of Floating Memories
properties.text:
Narrator: The cavernous room has no floor or ceiling, only floating wooden index drawers suspended in midair.
Narrator: As Mrs. O touches a floating drawer, a warm beam of golden light projects a vivid memory of the rainy afternoon when Mr. D proposed.
Mrs. O: Look, Henry... they didn't just record our dates and addresses. They harvested the actual feelings.
Mr. D: They use human love as the fuel to power their administrative engine.
Mrs. O: Then we're going to shut down their fuel supply forever.

properties.title: Audience with the Chief Archivist
properties.text:
Narrator: In a quiet, book-lined study lit by green shaded lamps, an ancient man in spectacles sits writing with a peacock feather quill.
The Archivist: Ah, Case Pair 409. I have watched your file for forty years.
Mr. D: Are you the one who ordered our revision?
The Archivist: I order nothing, young man. I merely archive what the High Auditor demands. But I have grown weary of watching beautiful lives shredded for bureaucratic symmetry.
Mrs. O: Then help us destroy their authority.
The Archivist: Take this crystal bottle of Unwritten Ink. Anything written with this ink becomes permanent, unalterable reality across all timelines.

properties.title: Rewriting the Master Ledger
properties.text:
Narrator: Mrs. O uncorks the bottle of Unwritten Ink and dips the peacock feather quill into the shimmering liquid.
Narrator: Across the Master Ledger page for Case Pair 409, she writes in bold, confident letters:
Mrs. O: "Mr. D and Mrs. O are permanently, eternally immune to administrative revision. Their marriage is absolute, unwritten, and unerasable."
Narrator: As the ink touches the parchment, brilliant golden light flares across the room.
Mr. D: Look at the stone walls... the grey courthouse architecture is dissolving back into warm sunlit air!

properties.title: Confrontation in the Courtroom
properties.text:
Narrator: Heavy oak doors slam shut behind Mrs. O and Mr. D as they step into the center aisle of the Forgotten Courtroom.
Narrator: High on the judicial bench stand Sheriff Harry Persad and Sheriff Sig Cho, their stamping rods glowing with angry purple light.
Sheriff Harry Persad: You are in violation of the Celestial Protocol, Case Pair 409!
Sheriff Sig Cho: Surrender your files immediately or face total narrative dissolution!
Mr. D: We surrender nothing to unauthorized clerks!
Mrs. O: We hold the Unwritten Ink and the Black Token. Your jurisdiction is revoked!

properties.title: The Rooftop Ascent
properties.text:
Narrator: The heavy iron door at the top of the stairwell bursts open, letting in cold wind and the bright golden light of sunset.
Narrator: Below them, the sprawling city skyline looks clearer and more real than ever before.
Renegade Janitor: Look! The courthouse building is shrinking! The citizens are pouring out into the street below!
Mrs. O: We did it, Henry. The whole building is breaking apart!
Mr. D: Let me hold your hand as we walk down to the street. We're going home.

properties.title: Ending - Authors of Reality
properties.text:
Narrator: With the Unwritten Ink, Mrs. O and Mr. D rewrite the entire bureaucratic system out of existence.
Narrator: They wake up in their own sunlit bedroom. The notice on the front door has vanished completely.
Mrs. O: Do you feel any different, Henry?
Mr. D: I feel like our past belongs to us now. Completely, permanently, and forever.
Narrator: Together, they step outside onto their porch, ready to live a life written entirely by their own hands.

properties.title: Ending - The Permanent Resistance
properties.text:
Narrator: Without their true birth names, the Unwritten Ink only partially shields them from bureaucratic oversight.
Narrator: Every year, Sheriff Harry Persad and Sheriff Sig Cho return to offer a new compromise.
Sheriff Harry Persad: Sign here to extend your memory permits for another decade.
Mrs. O: We will sign nothing that alters our love.
Mr. D: We remain together, fighting the bureau step by step, unyielding and untamed.

properties.title: Ending - Overthrow of the Sheriffs
properties.text:
Narrator: Mr. D places the Black Token onto the judge's gavel stand.
Narrator: A blinding pulse of white light shatters the gavels held by Sheriff Harry Persad and Sheriff Sig Cho.
Sheriff Sig Cho: Impossible... the Celestial Protocol has been overridden!
Sheriff Harry Persad: The office... is dissolved!
Narrator: The courtroom crumbles into dust as Mrs. O and Mr. D walk out as victors over the cosmic bureaucracy.

properties.title: Ending - Eternal Guardians of Memory
properties.text:
Narrator: Lacking full cosmic protocol knowledge, the Black Token creates a temporal lock.
Narrator: The Sheriff's Office freezes in time around them.
Mrs. O: The sheriffs can't touch us, but we can't leave either.
Mr. D: Then we stand guard together forever, protecting humanity from revision.

properties.title: Ending - The Great Emancipation
properties.text:
Narrator: Carrying the Master Ledger page, Mrs. O and Mr. D lead hundreds of freed citizens out into the city streets.
Narrator: As the citizens step into the sunlight, their names and histories instantly restore.
Renegade Janitor: You saved us all!
Mrs. O: We saved each other.
Narrator: Hand in hand, Mr. D and Mrs. O lead the newly freed populace into a bright, unscripted future.

properties.title: Ending - Quiet Freedom
properties.text:
Narrator: Though they didn't retrieve the Master Ledger page, their escape disrupts the local office's jurisdiction.
Narrator: They slip into the crowd of the city, anonymous and united.
Mr. D: The office may still be out there somewhere.
Mrs. O: Let them come. As long as we're together, they can never erase us.

properties.title: The High Auditor's Surrender
properties.text:
Narrator: The High Auditor drops his silver quill as alarms blare across every floor of the building.

properties.title: Exposing Secret Revision Bureau Memos
properties.text:
Narrator: Mrs. O uses the stolen clerk stamp to break the lead seal on a black leather folder marked TOP SECRET: DISTRICT AUDIT.
Mrs. O: Henry, look at this memo signed by Sheriff Harry Persad and Sheriff Sig Cho... "The Revision Bureau is an unauthorized rogue department operating without municipal approval."
Mr. D: They aren't cosmic judges! They're just rogue archivists who stole an old reality engine!
Mrs. O: Now we have the proof we need to shut them down forever!

properties.title: Executing the Counter-Audit Directive
properties.text:
Narrator: Mr. D firmly presses the clerk stamp onto the Master Counter-Audit Directive.
Narrator: A wave of golden light ripples out from the desk, washing down every corridor and dissolving every lead notice in the city.
Mrs. O: It's over, Henry. The whole system has been shut down!

properties.title: Ending - System Administrators of Freedom
properties.text:
Narrator: The monolithic granite courthouse melts away like snow, turning into a bright public park filled with blooming trees.
Narrator: Sheriff Harry Persad and Sheriff Sig Cho vanish like shadows under a midday sun.
Mr. D: We didn't just defeat their office... we gave everyone their lives back.
Mrs. O: And no clerk will ever try to write our story again.
Narrator: Hand in hand, Mr. D and Mrs. O walk together out of the park and back to their home.

properties.title: The Index of Nullified Timelines
properties.text:
Narrator: Below the Basement Archive lies a cold cavern illuminated by floating blue lanterns.
Narrator: Countless leather-bound volumes rest on iron shelves stretching into infinity.
Senior Registrar: You shouldn't be down here, Case 409. This is where erased years go to rot.
Mr. D: Take this Archival Lantern, Mrs. O. Its light reveals text written in invisible lead ink.
Mrs. O: Look at this shelf... "The Unseen Third Sheriff." It says there isn't just Persad and Cho... there is a third sheriff who operates in secret!
Mr. D: Then we uncover the Third Sheriff before we trigger the system reset!

properties.title: Unmasking the Protocol Officer

Narrator: As Mrs. O shines the Archival Lantern onto the Officer's silver badge, glowing letters appear across his chest.
Mrs. O: Your name isn't Chief Protocol Officer... your name is Arthur Vance! You were erased in 1988!

properties.title: The Sanctuary of the Unseen Sheriff
properties.text:
Narrator: Behind a heavy bronze door sits a quiet room filled with brass telescopes pointing up at the night sky.
Narrator: In a high leather chair sits the Unseen Third Sheriff, holding a silver pocket watch.
Unseen Third Sheriff: Thank you for coming, Case Pair 409. I have been waiting fifty years for a couple strong enough to breach this floor.
Mrs. O: Are you here to revise us too?
Unseen Third Sheriff: No. I am here to witness the moment human devotion destroys our artificial machinery. Take my watch... it unlocks the final counter-audit directive!

properties.title: Ending - Sovereignty of Memory
properties.text:
Narrator: Guided by the Unseen Third Sheriff, Mrs. O and Mr. D use the pocket watch to reset the building's timeline core.
Narrator: The courthouse silently folds into a single sheet of blank paper, leaving only the sky and stars above.
Mrs. O: We did it, Henry. They can never erase anyone again.
Mr. D: Our memories, our names, our marriage... belong to us forever.
Narrator: Together, they walk out into a free and unwritten world under the starlight.

nodes.title: The Notice on the Mahogany Door

properties.title: The Notice on the Mahogany Door
properties.text:
Narrator: Evening shadows stretch long across the quiet suburban street as Mr. D and Mrs. O return from their daily walk.
Narrator: Taped precisely to the center of their mahogany front door is a thick parchment document sealed with heavy blue lead.
Narrator: The seal bears an emblem of a pair of brass scales balancing an hourglass against a stack of filing cabinets.
Narrator: OFFICE OF THE SHERIFF. MANDATORY APPEARANCE AND REALITY REVISION NOTICE.
Mrs. O: Look at the names printed at the top of the header... it's not just one of us. Both of our names are printed side-by-side in dark iron ink.
Mr. D: "Case Pair 409. You are hereby instructed to present yourselves jointly at the District Courthouse, Floor 1, Desk B, between 9:00 AM and 5:00 PM."
Mrs. O: "Failure to report as a unified pair will result in immediate retroactive nullification of marital records and personal identity schedules."
Mr. D: Retroactive nullification? They make it sound like our entire life together is an overdue library book.
Mrs. O: Look at the serving officers listed at the bottom... Sheriff Harry Persad and Sheriff Sig Cho.
Mr. D: I don't care how many sheriffs or clerks they have. We built our life together, line by line. No office is going to erase that.
Mrs. O: We go in together, we ask the hard questions together, and we leave together. Whatever this system is hiding, we uncover it.

projectTitle: The Office of the Sheriff: The Bureaucracy of Shadows
